payload.acceptance_criteria:
When basicly worktree merge --mode ci lands a lane, then the full checks ran green on GitHub on the exact tree that main receives and the local run took only the local-only checks.
When two lanes land with --mode ci one after the other, then the second landing is not refused as NOT-READY for an unverified destination.
When main moves by code during the CI wait twice, or the CI run fails, is cancelled or passes only on a rerun, then the landing refuses by name, lands nothing and never force-pushes.
When main receives a CI-proved merge commit, then the quality-gates push run reuses the lane run and its shard jobs log reuse.
payload.description:
## Context
When a lane is ready, I want basicly worktree merge to prove it on GitHub runners instead of a local full verify with a machine-wide quiet window, so a landing costs about 1.5 min of local time instead of about 18 (measured 2026-11-19: ci-weights 17.8 min, ci-revert 18.3 min).

## Design (Orchestrator decisions 2026-11-19 13:28, 13:59 owner go, 15:12 corrections)
--mode ci: preflight as today; rebase; local-only checks (the 9 local_only checks, staged fast checks, tracker write); push the proved head to a new ref land/LANE/N (never force); dispatch quality-gates on it with base = main; wait (first attempt only, 15 min limit); if main moved by ledger commits only, rebase again and land when the tree outside .basicly/ledger equals the proved tree; if main moved by code, one new run, then refuse; merge --no-ff; landing-verification status ci-verified with the run URL and the proved tree, accepted by landing_guard.blocker; push main under the Orchestrator's standing push order; delete land/LANE/N. quality-gates gets a reuse step (actions: read, GH_TOKEN): main's push run skips its checks when the head is the merge commit M or ledger-only commits on it, tree(M) equals tree(M^2), and a first-attempt quality-gates run on M^2 succeeded. Fallback: --mode full stays.

## Links
basicly-svtn4op (CI budget), basicly-br1a0vq (landing lock, lands first). Landing this record's lane moves the local full verify to CI: the exact diff goes to the Orchestrator for the owner's relayed approval before it lands.
payload.title: Prove a landing on GitHub runners instead of a local full verify

payload.acceptance_criteria:
A PreToolUse Bash hook refuses git checkout -- path, git checkout HEAD -- path, git restore without --staged, git stash in any form except list and show, git reset --hard and git clean except its dry run. It also refuses them inside a chained command or after git -C. The refusal says that the command discards uncommitted work and is an ask-first item, and gives the remedy. git restore --staged, git stash list and git stash show pass.
The hook is registered and projected.
